annotations.title: Find SEND support near a postcode

description: Find state primary or secondary schools near a postcode in England with what is published about special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) at each: an SEN unit or resourced provision, the share of pupils on SEN support and with an EHC plan against the England median, the Parent View answer from parents of children with SEND, and a quote about SEND from the latest Ofsted inspection report with a link. Also gives the council's record on issuing EHC plans within 20 weeks and its latest area SEND inspection.

sen_provision.description: Only schools with an SEN unit or resourced provision

name: find_send_support
